SYNTHETIC — fictional market rules for tests; no legal authority.
CHAPTER 1
GENERAL PROVISIONS
1.1 SCOPE
This synthetic chapter sets out fictional provisions for grammar tests only.
1.1.1 A fictional participant shall file a fictional notice within one fictional day.
1.1.2 The fictional notice stays content under the fictional register.
1.1.3. A fictional clause may carry a trailing period after its label.
1.2 DEFINITIONS
1.2.1 Fictional terms are defined only in this synthetic document.
1.2.1.1 "Fictional day" means a fictional day that does not exist.
